13484 Northwest FWY Houston, TX 77040.

(832) 830-6180 (Daniel: store manager / Hiring manager)

Preparation Checklist:
•       Remember to dress business professional (always overdress!)

As an Energy Pro, You Will:
•       Report to the Retail Sales Manager.
•       Engage with Consumers about Reliant Electricity at our In-store locations.
•       Foster Professional Relationships with Customers and Fellow Employees.
•       Welcome customers and politely offer and up-sale solutions.
•       Collaborate with Your Team to Accomplish Goals and Celebrate Success.

Have a wonderful day and we look forward to meeting you!
